question: How do I make a sheet metal flange in Inventor?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Inventor 2026 Help, which is the newest release the sources describe; one page covers contour flanges (marked "What's New: 2026") and another covers regular flanges (marked "What's New: 2025") [3][4].

To make a regular flange, go to Sheet Metal tab > Create panel > Flange [4]. Edge Select Mode is active by default, so select an edge [4]. Then set the Height Extents (Distance, or To with a geometry that defines the height) and use Flipped to change which side of the face the flange is on [4]. Under Angle and Placement, set the angle, or set Flange Angle to By Reference to match a selected planar face or plane [4]. For multi-edge flanges, click a corner glyph to adjust Corner Overrides (relief, shape, gap size, relief size) [4]. Click Apply to add more flanges, or OK when you're finished [4].

If you want a flange built from an open profile sketch instead, use the same Sheet Metal tab > Create panel > Flange command to create a contour flange [3]. In the property panel, choose an open profile (if none exists, you're placed in the sketch environment to create one) and pick the SM Rule [3]. In the Behavior group, set parameters such as From, and use Default, Flipped or Symmetric for how the profile is used [3]. In Bend Properties, set the Bend Radius and Unfold Rule, then click OK or Apply [3]. To add a contour flange to an existing sheet metal face, create the sketch profile on a face perpendicular to the edge [3].

If a new flange merges into an existing face, try using an offset plane to define it [4]. Identical symmetrical flanges can be made with the Mirror command [4].

studyNotes.focus: The user wants the basic steps to create a sheet metal flange feature in Autodesk Inventor.

keyPoints.text: A flange can be created along an edge or edge loop, or aligned with an existing face, to add a sheet metal face and bend connected to an existing sheet metal face.
To create a flange, on the ribbon go to the Sheet Metal tab, Create panel, and click Flange, then select an edge in Edge Select Mode.
Set the height extent (Distance or To geometry), the angle and placement, and optionally flip the side of the flange, then click Apply to add more or OK to finish.

A contour flange is a separate feature for a multi-edge profile; it is created from an open sketch profile by clicking Flange on the Sheet Metal tab, with the profile automatically selected if one exists.
Corner settings such as relief type and radius can be adjusted via the Corner tab or Corner Overrides, and corner relief applies when creating the flat pattern.
